typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		PIPE_OPP_UID as string,
		STATUS as string,
		REASON as string,
		STATUS_DATE as string,
		Close_Date as string,
		ContactId as string,
		OwnerId as string,
		{Opportunity Name} as string,
		RecordTypeId as string,
		FILE_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['raw/ib_kpma_oppstatus*']) ~> source1
source(output(
		RecordTypeId as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['raw/opp_record_type_id.csv']) ~> RecordTypeId
DerivedColumn1 split((isNull(PIPE_OPP_UID)&&(isNull(ContactId)||isNull(OwnerId)||isNull({Opportunity Name})))||isNull(STATUS)||isNull(STATUS_DATE)||isNull(Close_Date),
	disjoint: false) ~> ConditionalSplit1@(rejectNULL, toSFDC)
source1 derive(ADFId__c = uuid()) ~> DerivedColumn1
DerivedColumn2 select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		Id = PIPE_OPP_UID,
		StageName = STATUS,
		Reason_Lost__c = REASON,
		Status_Date__c = STATUS_DATE,
		CloseDate = Close_Date,
		Primary_Contact__c = ContactId,
		OwnerId,
		Name = {Opportunity Name},
		RecordTypeId
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select1
ConditionalSplit1@rejectNULL derive(REJECT_REASON = concat('ADF:Field contain NULL value: ', iif(isNull(STATUS), 'STATUS ', ''), iif(isNull(STATUS_DATE), 'STATUS_DATE ', ''), iif(isNull(PIPE_OPP_UID)&&isNull(ContactId), 'ContactId ', ''), iif(isNull(Close_Date), 'Close_Date ', ''), iif(isNull(PIPE_OPP_UID)&&isNull(OwnerId), 'OwnerId ', ''), iif(isNull(PIPE_OPP_UID)&&isNull({Opportunity Name}), 'Opportunity Name', ''))) ~> rejectREASON
rejectREASON select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		REJECT_REASON
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select2
Join1 derive(STATUS_DATE = coalesce(toString(toDate(STATUS_DATE, 'yyyyMMdd')),STATUS_DATE),
		Close_Date = coalesce(toString(toDate(Close_Date, 'yyyyMMdd')),Close_Date),
		RecordTypeId = coalesce(RecordTypeId, lookRecId)) ~> DerivedColumn2
Select1 split(isNull(Id),
	disjoint: false) ~> ConditionalSplit2@(insert, upsert)
ConditionalSplit2@insert derive(Language__c = iifNull(Id,"English")) ~> DerivedColumn3
RecordTypeId select(mapColumn(
		lookRecId = RecordTypeId
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select3
ConditionalSplit1@toSFDC, Select3 join(1 == 1,
	joinType:'inner',
	matchType:'exact',
	ignoreSpaces: false,
	broadcast: 'right')~> Join1
ConditionalSplit2@upsert sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:[('ib_kpma_oppstatus_Opportunity.csv')],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	saveOrder: 1,
	mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		Id,
		StageName,
		Reason_Lost__c,
		Status_Date__c,
		CloseDate,
		OwnerId,
		Name,
		RecordTypeId
	),
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> upsertOutput
Select2 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:[('ib_kpma_oppstatus_source_reject.csv')],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> rejectOUTPUT
DerivedColumn1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:[('ib_kpma_oppstatus_raw.csv')],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> curatedRaw
DerivedColumn3 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['ib_kpma_oppstatus_Opportunity.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> insertOutput
